3|def transform(grid):

14|        r,c=q.popleft()
15|        for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
16|            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]==bg and (nr,nc) not in outside:
17|                outside.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
18|    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; seen=set(outside)
19|    for r in range(h):

22|            comp=[]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c))
